title: Instant
wikitext:
'''Instant''' is a keyword that refers to skills with no use time, allowing them to be used without playing an animation or interrupting ongoing actions.

==Mechanics==
Instant skills can be used while using a non-instant skill or while moving, and do not interrupt or cancel the action. They cannot be used when skills cannot be used, e.g. when the character has 0% [[action speed]] due to [[Freeze]], or while [[Stun|stunned]].<ref name="InstantSkills"/> Instant skills cannot be bound to the Left-Click button.

[[Guard Skill|Guard skills]], some movement skills, and the toggling of [[aura]]s and other [[reservation]] skills are a few examples of instant skills. Some instant skills, like {{il|Frostblink}}, will be used repeatedly as long as their bound key is held down, while others, like most [[reservation]] skills, will activate only once.

All instant skills have a [[cooldown]].<ref name="Cooldown"/>
